item.title: Correction · Prequel Park (interim): The BCDC permit tracker gives June 19, 2025 as the date the application for non-material amendment 2019.006.02 was received and June 26, 2026 as the date it was issued; the map notes and the site timeline entry had shown June 19, 2025 as the issue date and now show June 26, 2026. The timeline entry for the November 18, 2025 Port Commission vote now cites the meeting minutes instead of a bare domain. The record no longer calls California Barrel Company the property owner (the Port owns this land; the company is its lessee), no longer says Resolution 20-12 'first designates' the Port sub-area for open space, and now names California Barrel Company LLC alongside Fifth Space as publisher of the developer's website.

item.title: Correction · Prequel Park (interim): This record's map notes cited no source; they now cite the Port Commission's November 2025 memo (about 2 acres, about 0.4 acre on Port land), the final Design for Development and the Chronicle. A 'Spring 2026 construction-pipeline' listing that could not be found online was dropped as a source, and the note saying construction is proceeding per that listing was replaced by the memo's Q3 2026 target with the statement that no source confirms a start. The record no longer calls the company the property owner or says the 2020 approval 'first covers' this sub-area, the Unit 3 description now says the Chronicle does not name it, and an earlier change entry was re-dated as a coverage entry and re-cited to the Port memo and the Chronicle.
item.description: This record's map notes cited no source; they now cite the Port Commission's November 2025 memo (about 2 acres, about 0.4 acre on Port land), the final Design for Development and the Chronicle. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 10A memo, 2025-11-14 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-11/111825_10a_potrero_power_station_lease_amendment_0.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); San Francisco Chronicle, 2025-05-22 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/power-station-park-sf-20339020.php).

item.title: Correction · Prequel Park (interim): This record's map status was corrected from 'under construction' to 'planned'. The timeline had shown 'under construction' today but 'planned' a couple of years into the future. No dated source has ever confirmed that construction has started, and the map status had simply never been corrected to match; the sibling 'Prequel Park (Port sub-area)' record already said 'planned'.
